entries.name: Turtwig
entries.rationale: Spe 31 and quadruped shape keep it slow and unable to carry the ball; def 64 and the shell-armor ability suit a holding defensive post. Baseline already reflects this, so no change.

entries.name: Grotle
entries.rationale: Quadruped shape on a tortoise body with stubby legs cannot spring for headers, so AER eases a little. Atk 89 and def 85 keep it a sturdy ball-winner in front of goal.

entries.name: Torterra
entries.rationale: A quadruped tortoise of genus Continent cannot spring for headers, so AER eases; the Layer 1 heavy penalty from weight 3100 hg already covers its diving. Height 22, def 105 and genus Continent make it a wall that fills the goalmouth or the centre.

entries.name: Chimchar
entries.rationale: Spe 61 on a small upright chimp with blaze-kick and double-kick in kickMoves already earned large Layer 1 boosts; hp 44 and weight 62 hg leave it light in contact.

entries.name: Monferno
entries.rationale: Fire/fighting type with spe 81 and a kicking kit (double-kick, low-kick) already rewarded by Layer 1; def 52 leaves it a poor defender. Genus Playful fits a free attacking role.

entries.name: Infernape
entries.rationale: Spe 108 and its acrobatic fire/fighting style already show in ACC 87, which now tracks its speed, so no burst bump is needed. Def 71 and spd 71 are the only soft spots, so it plays high up the pitch.

entries.name: Piplup
entries.rationale: Genus Penguin means short legs and flippers, so the humanoid shape bonus to DRI and HAN overstates it. Spa 61 is its best stat and suits a deep passer; spe 40 rules out the flanks.

entries.name: Prinplup
entries.rationale: Penguin genus with flippers rather than hands makes HAN 60 generous. Spa 81 and spd 76 point to a measured central passer; spe 50 keeps it off the wings.

entries.name: Empoleon
entries.rationale: Genus Emperor and spa 111 suit a commanding deep playmaker, and water/steel type with def 88 holds the middle. Steel flippers, not hands, so HAN 87 drops; spe 60 and height 17 make it slow to turn.

entries.name: Starly
entries.rationale: Spe 60 and the wings shape make it a nuisance runner; Layer 1 already trims DRI for the wings shape and the baseline already reflects height 3 and weight 20 hg, so no change.

entries.name: Staravia
entries.rationale: Spe 80 and wings shape give pace and aerial reach that Layer 1 already counted, and the intimidate ability already lifted TAK. No further change.

entries.name: Staraptor
entries.rationale: Atk 120, spe 100 and the reckless ability make it a direct, head-first attacker who goes through players rather than around them, so DRI trims slightly.

entries.name: Bidoof
entries.rationale: Genus Plump Mouse with spe 31 and atk 45 is slow and blunt; the unaware ability lets it ignore pressure, which is the one thing it brings. Baseline is already low across the board.

entries.name: Bibarel
entries.rationale: Genus Beaver is a builder and grinder, not a dribbler, so DRI 75 overstates it. Hp 79 and atk 85 make it a durable shuttler on the flank or in front of the back line.

entries.name: Kricketot
entries.rationale: Height 3, weight 22 hg and atk 25 leave nothing physical; its only edge is the small humanoid frame Layer 1 already rewarded in DRI and TEC.

entries.name: Kricketune
entries.rationale: Atk 85 and spe 65 suit a direct runner, and bug-wings shape already lifted AER. Spa 55 and spd 51 give little to build play with.

entries.name: Shinx
entries.rationale: A small quadruped cub at weight 95 hg with atk 65; intimidate and guts already lifted TAK and ACC in Layer 1. Quadruped shape limits passing.

entries.name: Luxio
entries.rationale: Atk 85 on a quadruped big cat with spe 60 suits a forward who presses; intimidate already counted. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Luxray
entries.rationale: Genus Gleam Eyes is the franchise's see-through-anything lion, so VIS gets a lift. Atk 120 and the intimidate ability make it a predatory forward who can also win the ball back.

entries.name: Budew
entries.rationale: IsBaby with height 2 and weight 12 hg; Layer 1 already applied the baby penalties. Spe 55 is its only asset.

entries.name: Roserade
entries.rationale: Spa 125 and spe 90 make it an elegant creator. Its hands are bouquets, so the humanoid HAN bonus is wrong; def 65 and weight 145 hg keep it out of duels.

entries.name: Cranidos
entries.rationale: Genus Head Butt and head-smash in kickMoves mark a battering ram; atk 125 drives shots. Tiny arms and a charge-first style do not fit DRI 71, and spa 30 gives no vision.

entries.name: Rampardos
entries.rationale: Atk 165 and genus Head Butt make it the purest header in the gen, already counted via head-smash. TEC 84 overstates first touch for a ram with spa 65; weight 1025 hg kills acceleration.

entries.name: Shieldon
entries.rationale: Genus Shield with def 118 blocks with its face plate, and the quadruped shape already costs HAN in Layer 1, so no change. Spe 30 limits it to a static defender.

entries.name: Bastiodon
entries.rationale: Def 168 and genus Shield make it a literal wall that can stand in the goal or the box. The quadruped shape already costs HAN in Layer 1, so no change; spe 30 rules out running.

entries.name: Burmy
entries.rationale: A blob shape at height 2 inside a bagworm cloak; Layer 1 already cut its technical attributes hard. Def 45 and overcoat ability are all it offers.

entries.name: Wormadam
entries.rationale: Spd 105 and anticipation suit reading play, but a blob shape at height 5 and weight 65 hg cannot cover a goal, so GKP 89 is too high. Spe 36 keeps it central.

entries.name: Mothim
entries.rationale: Atk 94 and spa 94 with spe 66 suit a mobile forward; bug-wings shape already lifted AER. Def 50 makes it fragile.

entries.name: Combee
entries.rationale: Spe 70 on a tiny heads shape at weight 55 hg gives quickness but nothing else; as a three-bee unit it is a natural hive worker. Atk 30 offers no shot.

entries.name: Vespiquen
entries.rationale: Genus Beehive queen with def 102 and spd 102 commands a back line, and the pressure ability adds presence. Spe 40 keeps it deep; baseline already fits.

entries.name: Pachirisu
entries.rationale: Spe 95 on a quadruped squirrel at height 4 and weight 39 hg is all burst and no power; atk 45 gives no shot. Baseline already captures it.

entries.name: Buizel
entries.rationale: Spe 85 and swift-swim on a sleek quadruped give pace; def 35 and spd 30 leave it no defensive value. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Floatzel
entries.rationale: Spe 115 and atk 105 make it a fast direct attacker; low-kick in kickMoves already counted. Def 55 and spd 50 keep it forward.

entries.name: Cherubi
entries.rationale: A heads shape at height 4 with spa 62 as its best stat; Layer 1 already cut DRI and TEC for having no real feet. Spe 35 limits it.

entries.name: Cherrim
entries.rationale: Spe 85 and spa 87 give a light creator, and the flower-gift ability exists to boost allies. Height 5 and weight 93 hg keep it out of physical duels.

entries.name: Shellos
entries.rationale: A squiggle-shape sea slug with no limbs and spe 34; Layer 1 already cut its ball skills. Hp 76 is its one strength.

entries.name: Gastrodon
entries.rationale: Hp 111 drives STA 92 and storm-drain soaks pressure, but the squiggle shape and spe 39 already cost it every ball skill in Layer 1. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Ambipom
entries.rationale: Genus Long Tail refers to its hand-tipped twin tails, which give it far better grip than HAN 60 shows. Spe 115 with the technician and skill-link abilities make it a slippery wide attacker.

entries.name: Drifloon
entries.rationale: Genus Balloon at weight 12 hg drifts rather than bursts, so ACC 80 is too high; ghost/flying type keeps it floating for aerial balls. Hp 90 gives it running power.

entries.name: Drifblim
entries.rationale: Genus Blimp, height 12 and weight 150 hg describe a floating envelope that drifts into position rather than sprinting, so ACC 79 drops and AER rises. Hp 150 makes it tireless.

entries.name: Buneary
entries.rationale: Genus Rabbit and jump-kick plus mega-kick in kickMoves make it a leaping striker; Layer 1 boosted kicks but not its spring, so AER rises. Weight 55 hg keeps it light.

entries.name: Lopunny
entries.rationale: Genus Rabbit with high-jump-kick in kickMoves and spe 105 is the franchise's kicking leaper, so AER gets the jump Layer 1 missed. Its reflex numbers suit a keeper on paper, but it belongs up front.

entries.name: Mismagius
entries.rationale: Spe 105 and spa 105 with the levitate ability make it a drifting creator; the ball shape already cost it DRI and HAN in Layer 1. Weight 44 hg means no physical game.

entries.name: Honchkrow
entries.rationale: Genus Big Boss with atk 125 and the moxie ability fits a forward who feeds on scoring. Wings shape already lifted AER and cut footwork, and def 52 keeps it out of defence.

entries.name: Glameow
entries.rationale: Spe 85 on a quadruped cat at weight 39 hg is quick and balanced but light; atk 55 gives little end product. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Purugly
entries.rationale: Spe 112 is real despite the round design, and weight 438 hg plus the thick-fat and defiant abilities make it a bruising runner. Quadruped shape already limits passing.

entries.name: Chingling
entries.rationale: IsBaby at height 2 and weight 6 hg with the levitate ability; Layer 1 already applied the baby penalties. Spa 65 is its only strength.

entries.name: Stunky
entries.rationale: Spe 74 on a small quadruped skunk; the stench ability makes opponents flinch, which counts for presence. Atk 63 and quadruped shape give little else.

entries.name: Skuntank
entries.rationale: Hp 103 and spe 84 keep it running all game, and the stench ability backs its presence. Quadruped shape already capped passing in Layer 1.

entries.name: Bronzor
entries.rationale: A ball-shape bronze disc with def 86, weight 605 hg and spe 23; Layer 1 already cut its ball skills. It blocks and nothing more.

entries.name: Bronzong
entries.rationale: Genus Bronze Bell with def 116 and weight 1870 hg is an immovable blocker. Its arms shape is two stubby nubs on a bell, so the +10 HAN from Layer 1 overshoots.

entries.name: Bonsly
entries.rationale: IsBaby rock with def 95 and spe 10; the sturdy and rock-head abilities make it hard to knock over but spa 10 gives no vision. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Mime Jr.
entries.rationale: Genus Mime suits a trickster creator, and spd 90 with technician lifts its touch. IsBaby penalties already applied; hp 20 leaves it no stamina.

entries.name: Happiny
entries.rationale: Hp 100 gives it stamina, but atk 5 and def 5 mean it cannot shoot or tackle. IsBaby penalties already applied.

entries.name: Chatot
entries.rationale: Spe 91 on a wings shape at weight 19 hg is quick but tiny; genus Music Note and its mimicry identity add surprise. Layer 1 already cut footwork.

entries.name: Spiritomb
entries.rationale: Genus Forbidden, a blob shape bound to a keystone at weight 1080 hg, cannot run; def 108 and spd 108 plus the pressure ability make it a looming holding presence.

entries.name: Gible
entries.rationale: Genus Land Shark with atk 70 and a stocky upright shape suits a physical forward or stopper; spe 42 and spa 40 hold it back. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Gabite
entries.rationale: Spe 82 and atk 90 at height 14 make it a direct runner; spa 50 limits creativity. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Garchomp
entries.rationale: Genus Mach describes a jet-like burst beyond what ACC 80 shows, so ACC gets a small lift. Its arms end in fins and claws, so HAN 89 overstates a keeper's grip; atk 130 makes it an elite striker.

entries.name: Munchlax
entries.rationale: Genus Big Eater, weight 1050 hg and spe 5 mean it plants and blocks; hp 135 and the thick-fat ability keep it going. IsBaby penalties already applied.

entries.name: Riolu
entries.rationale: Fighting type with high-jump-kick and blaze-kick in kickMoves already earned Layer 1 boosts; isBaby with hp 40 leaves it slight. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Lucario
entries.rationale: Genus Aura is the franchise's aura-reading fighter, which lifts its reading of play. The steadfast and inner-focus abilities give calm, and its kickMoves already maxed the shooting attributes.

entries.name: Hippopotas
entries.rationale: Genus Hippo on a quadruped shape with def 78 and spe 32 is a plodding blocker. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Hippowdon
entries.rationale: Genus Heavyweight on a squat quadruped hippo body cannot spring for headers, so AER eases; the Layer 1 heavy penalty from weight 3000 hg already covers its diving. Def 118 and atk 112 make it a bulldozer at the back.

entries.name: Skorupi
entries.rationale: Genus Scorpion with an armor shape and def 90 grabs with pincers and tail; spa 30 gives no creativity. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Drapion
entries.rationale: Genus Ogre Scorpion with long clawed arms, def 110 and spe 95 makes a rangy defender; battle-armor and keen-eye already shaped Layer 1. Spa 60 limits passing.

entries.name: Croagunk
entries.rationale: Genus Toxic Mouth, a poison/fighting frog with low-kick and mega-kick in kickMoves already rewarded by Layer 1; hp 48 and def 40 leave it slight.

entries.name: Toxicroak
entries.rationale: Atk 106 and spe 85 on a poison/fighting humanoid with mega-kick in kickMoves make a sharp forward. Def 65 keeps it out of defence.

entries.name: Carnivine
entries.rationale: Genus Bug Catcher with tentacles shape and levitate hangs and snaps rather than runs; atk 100 backs its tackling. Spe 46 keeps it central.

entries.name: Finneon
entries.rationale: A fish shape at height 4 with no legs; Layer 1 already cut its outfield attributes hard. Spe 66 survives only as reflexes.

entries.name: Lumineon
entries.rationale: Fish shape strips its outfield skills in Layer 1, leaving spe 91 and spd 86 as reflexes and positioning. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Mantyke
entries.rationale: IsBaby manta with wings shape and spd 120; atk 20 gives no shot. Layer 1 already penalised it.

entries.name: Snover
entries.rationale: Genus Frost Tree at height 10 and weight 505 hg with spe 40 is a slow, solid presence. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Abomasnow
entries.rationale: Genus Frost Tree describes a stiff, tree-like giant at height 22 that lacks fine touch, so TEC trims slightly. Hp 90 and atk 92 hold the middle.

entries.name: Weavile
entries.rationale: Spe 125 and genus Sharp Claw make a darting attacker, and the pickpocket ability fits a player who steals the ball. Def 65 and weight 340 hg leave it light in contact.

entries.name: Magnezone
entries.rationale: Genus Magnet Area, def 115 and spa 130 make it a commanding deep anchor. Its arms shape is magnet units, not hands, so the +14 HAN from Layer 1 overshoots.

entries.name: Lickilicky
entries.rationale: Genus Licking with its long tongue reaches loose balls, hp 110 drives STA 94, and weight 1400 hg holds ground. Spe 50 keeps it deep.

entries.name: Rhyperior
entries.rationale: Atk 140 and def 130 make a battering presence; weight 2828 hg already costs AER through the Layer 1 heavy penalty, so no change. Genus Drill suits a target forward or stopper.

entries.name: Tangrowth
entries.rationale: Genus Vine with def 125 and the regenerator ability reaches with its vines and lasts; spe 50 keeps it deep. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Electivire
entries.rationale: Atk 123 and spe 95 on a heavy upright frame at weight 1386 hg with mega-kick in kickMoves make a powerful forward. Motor-drive already lifted ACC.

entries.name: Magmortar
entries.rationale: Genus Blast with spa 125 suits a long-range creator, but its arms are cannons rather than hands, so HAN 71 drops. Def 67 keeps it out of defence.

entries.name: Togekiss
entries.rationale: Spa 120 and spd 115 suit a deep passer, and wings shape plus height 15 give it span to cover goal. Atk 50 and the wings shape already cost it footwork in Layer 1.

entries.name: Yanmega
entries.rationale: Spe 95 with the speed-boost ability and bug-wings shape already earned Layer 1 pace and aerial boosts. Def 86 is fine but it plays high.

entries.name: Leafeon
entries.rationale: Spe 95 with atk 110 and def 130 on a quadruped shape makes a two-way wide runner. Quadruped already capped passing.

entries.name: Glaceon
entries.rationale: Spa 130 and def 110 suit a reading midfielder; height 8 and weight 259 hg rule out keeping despite GKP 93. Atk 60 gives little shot.

entries.name: Gliscor
entries.rationale: Genus Fang Scorpion gliding on wings shape with def 125 and the poison-heal ability makes a rangy aerial defender. Spa 45 gives no creativity.

entries.name: Mamoswine
entries.rationale: Genus Twin Tusk on a quadruped mammoth body cannot spring for headers, so AER eases; the Layer 1 heavy penalty from weight 2910 hg already covers its diving. Atk 130 and its tusks make it a charging presence.

entries.name: Porygon-Z
entries.rationale: Spa 135 with the adaptability and download abilities suits a creator; genus Virtual and its well-known glitchy program make it erratic. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Gallade
entries.rationale: Genus Blade with atk 125 and the steadfast and justified abilities make a disciplined swordsman forward; its kickMoves already lifted the attacking attributes. Def 65 is the weak spot.

entries.name: Probopass
entries.rationale: Genus Compass with def 145 and weight 3400 hg is a fixed blocker. A heads shape with no hands should not carry HAN 96, so it drops.

entries.name: Dusknoir
entries.rationale: Genus Gripper with its big hands, height 22 and def 135 is a natural keeper; the arms shape already lifted HAN in Layer 1. Spe 45 rules out outfield running.

entries.name: Froslass
entries.rationale: Spe 110 on an ice/ghost type gives pace. The arms shape floats with no feet, and Layer 1 already takes DRI, TEC and SHO down for it, so no further trim. Weight 266 hg keeps it light.

entries.name: Rotom
entries.rationale: Height 3 and weight 3 hg on a ball shape with spe 91; Layer 1 already cut its ball skills. Electric/ghost type darts about unpredictably.

entries.name: Uxie
entries.rationale: Genus Knowledge suits a player who reads the game, so VIS rises. Def 130 and spd 130 with spe 95 cover ground, but height 3 and weight 3 hg give no physical edge.

entries.name: Mesprit
entries.rationale: Even 105 spread across atk, spa, def and spd gives a balanced creator; height 3 and weight 3 hg keep it out of physical duels. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Azelf
entries.rationale: Atk 125, spa 125 and spe 115 make it the attacking member of the trio, and genus Willpower fits a tireless runner. Def 70 at weight 3 hg makes it fragile.

entries.name: Dialga
entries.rationale: A 6830 hg quadruped cannot dive, and the Layer 1 heavy penalty of DIV -9 already says so; height 54 still gives it aerial reach. Def 120 and spa 150 suit a dominant central anchor.

entries.name: Palkia
entries.rationale: Spa 150 and atk 120 on an upright giant at height 42 cover both ends; weight 3360 hg already slowed ACC in Layer 1. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Heatran
entries.rationale: Genus Lava Dome, a 4300 hg quadruped, cannot dive, and the Layer 1 heavy penalty of DIV -6 already covers it. Def 106 and spa 130 suit a deep anchor.

entries.name: Regigigas
entries.rationale: Genus Colossal with atk 160 at height 37 dominates. Weight 4200 already trims DIV and ability Slow Start already cut PAC and ACC in Layer 1, but a body that starts slowly should not react like REF 95 between the posts, so REF -6.

entries.name: Giratina
entries.rationale: Genus Renegade at weight 7500 hg on a tentacles shape cannot dive, and the Layer 1 heavy penalty of DIV -9 already covers it. Hp 150 and def 120 make it a towering anchor.

entries.name: Cresselia
entries.rationale: Genus Lunar with hp 120, def 110 and spd 120 is a resilient deep presence; the squiggle shape already stripped its ball skills. Levitate keeps it airborne.

entries.name: Phione
entries.rationale: Even 80 stats on a tiny arms shape at weight 31 hg; genus Sea Drifter fits a roaming wide player. Baseline fits.

entries.name: Manaphy
entries.rationale: Even 100 stats on a humanoid shape at height 3 and weight 14 hg make a gifted little creator with no physical presence. Weight already holds PHY at 62, so only HAN drops, for a body with no reach to handle a shot.

entries.name: Darkrai
entries.rationale: Spe 125 and spa 135 make a fast playmaker, and genus Pitch-Black with the bad-dreams ability gives an unsettling presence. Def 90 is the soft spot.

entries.name: Shaymin
entries.rationale: Even 100 stats on a quadruped hedgehog at height 2 and weight 21 hg give quickness and stamina but no physical game, and weight already holds PHY at 63. Height 2 gives no reach to handle a shot, so HAN drops.

entries.name: Arceus
entries.rationale: Genus Alpha with 120 in every stat dominates; weight 3200 hg already costs DIV through the Layer 1 heavy penalty, so no change. Height 32 keeps its aerial reach.
